query:
DELETE FROM pings p
         USING checks c
         CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
             SELECT created_at, id FROM pings
             WHERE check_id = c.id
             ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
             OFFSET $1 LIMIT 1
         ) cut
         WHERE p.check_id = c.id
           AND (p.created_at, p.id) <= (cut.created_at, cut.id)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incidents i WHERE i.cause_ping_id = p.id)
